pollingInterval.description: DEPRECATED — this value is no longer used and can be removed from your config.

logLevel.description: Minimum log level written to the Homebridge console.

accessoryType.description: Default HomeKit accessory type for all speakers. 'lightbulb' exposes volume via Brightness.

presetsServer.description: Local HTTP server that serves station descriptors and proxies audio streams for internet radio presets.

port.description: Port for the preset server. Defaults to 18090.

host.description: LAN IP or hostname the SoundTouch device should use to reach Homebridge. Auto-detected when omitted.

presetSyncInterval.description: How often (ms) to re-write presets to the device. Set to 0 to write at startup only.

presets.description: List of preset slots to manage on the SoundTouch device.

type.description: Preset type. Currently only 'station' (internet radio) is supported.

slot.description: Preset button slot on the device (1–6).

tuneInId.description: TuneIn station ID (e.g. 's24861'). Find the ID at tunein.com — it appears in the station URL.

imageUrl.description: Optional image URL for the station artwork.
